title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–213 assembles conservative interior convective/viscous residual; transient physical derivative coefficients are inconsistent, so structural equations alone do not validate results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:68 reads CGNS; partition.cpp builds local topology. Full mesh is retained on every rank during solve; independent geometry oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–276 assembles face/boundary residuals, :662–677 adds physical term. Transient term is not claimed BDF2 and case accuracy is limited.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:181–194 selects Roe by default or optional Rusanov; physics.cpp contains flux algorithms. Report claims Roe; production fallback-switch use is not established.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–276 handles farfield, wall pressure and adiabatic viscous path; :705–751 outputs wall values. No-slip surface reports zero velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:33–137 LSQ gradients and :138–200 limiter feed solver.cpp:153–170. Optional CFD_FIRST_ORDER exists; no production use established. No order-convergence study supplied.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:138–200 implements Barth–Jespersen and positivity fallback, called by solver.cpp:163–170. Optional bypass exists, but production activation not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:196–213,263–276 computes viscous face/wall fluxes; :606–624 projects wall traction tangentially. Laminar plateau histories have limited convergence evidence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:470–481 performs forward/backward LU-SGS and :1233 onward inner relaxation; short steady runs use residual/force plateau criterion.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Report.tex:304–307 claims BDF2, but sole transient residual solver.cpp:666–673,1435–1437 uses 1.5(U−Un)+0.5(U−Unm1), not BDF2 and not a consistent time derivative; this exact solver.cpp blob matches production commit. Full-horizon data/inner ratios belong to that different residual.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:36 uses METIS but main.cpp:112–127 replicates full mesh on all ranks throughout solve, contrary to TASK.md:227; np4/8 outputs alone do not establish order-one mismatch.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
